# chat-human — Full Agent Skill & Linter Reference (`v0.2.0`)

> Canonical Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & developer reference for `NB-Corp/chat-human` (`v0.2.0`, MIT License).
> Repository: `https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human` · PA Plugins, Protocol & Playground: `https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak/`.

---

## 1. Positioning: Prose Humanizers vs. Personal Agent IM Physics

Generic prose "humanizer" skills (`humanizer`, `Humanizer-zh`) rewrite essays and blog posts. When developers connect a **Personal Agent** (`OpenClaw`, `AstrBot`, `Claude Code`, `Codex`, custom Telegram/WhatsApp/WeChat/QQ/Slack/Discord bots) to live mobile messaging, prose prompts fail to stop:
- Raw `|---|---|` Markdown pipe tables wrapping into unreadable pipe soup on narrow phone screens (`openclaw#36323`);
- 200-word bulleted corporate walls and concierge sign-offs (`"Hope this helps! Let me know if you need anything!"`);
- Built-in regex splitters refusing to split replies `>150` chars or chopping fenced code blocks into broken fragments (`AstrBot#8614`).

`chat-human` separates mobile delivery mechanics from character identity:

1. **Layer 1 · Universal Bubble Physics (Always Active)**:
   - `1–4` short beats (`4–28` CJK chars or `4–22` English words per bubble; cumulative turn budget `<= 55` CJK chars or `<= 45` English words).
   - Omit formal trailing periods (`.` / `。`) on single-clause short beats and after copyable codes/IDs (`663920`).
   - Zero `#` headings, Markdown pipe tables, code fences, bullet checklists, RPG stage brackets (`*sighs*`, `（叹气）`), or concierge triads inside bubbles—offload code/SQL/tables to artifact cards or dedicated formatted blocks.
   - Pure text bubbles + artifact offload are the default (`enableVoiceNotes = false`); voice notes (`tts` / `voice_note`) are strictly opt-in (compatible with any generic OpenAI `/v1/audio/speech` endpoint, local TTS, or Web Speech—at most `1` per turn on the final bubble, `<50%` character-bigram overlap, spoken-word numbers, silent fallback on error).
2. **Layer 2 · Pluggable Persona & Mood Adapter**:
   - Priority order: **(1)** Explicit current-turn user instruction > **(2)** Active `SOUL.md` / `PERSONA.md` / AstrBot or OpenClaw persona > **(3)** Channel context (1-on-1 DM vs group channel) > **(4)** **Neutral Peer Baseline** (equal-footing colleague, zero uninvited roleplay, zero Unicode emoji spam).

## 2. Installation Across Personal Agents & Harnesses

| Runtime / Personal Agent Surface | Package / Path | One-Line Command |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kiki (`skills.sh`)** | [`NB-Corp/chat-human`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human) · `.claude-plugin/` | `npx skills add NB-Corp/chat-human --global --agent '*'` |
| **MCP Clients (Cursor / Cherry / Cline / Zed)** | `@nb-corp/nb-speak-mcp` (`io.github.NB-Corp/nb-speak`) | `npx -y github:NB-Corp/nb-speak mcp` |
| **OpenClaw (Telegram / WhatsApp / Discord / Signal)** | `@nb-corp/nb-speak-openclaw` ([`NB-Corp/nb-speak`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak)) | `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak openclaw --apply` |
| **AstrBot (QQ / WeChat / Telegram / Feishu)** | [`NB-Corp/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak) | `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/NB-Corp/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak <AstrBot>/data/plugins/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak` |
| **LangBot v4+ (WeChat / QQ / Feishu / DingTalk)** | [`NB-Corp/langbot_plugin_nb_speak`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/langbot_plugin_nb_speak) | `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/NB-Corp/langbot_plugin_nb_speak` |
| **Koishi v4 / NoneBot2 / OpenWebUI** | `koishi-plugin-nb-speak` · `nonebot-plugin-nb-speak` · `nb_speak_filter.py` | `npm i koishi-plugin-nb-speak` · `nb plugin install nonebot-plugin-nb-speak` |
| **OpenAI / SSE Bridge & DSH** | `@nb-corp/nb-speak` · [`NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh`](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak-dsh) | `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak serve --port 18090` |

## 3. Zero-Dependency Python 3.10+ Utilities

### 3.1 `skills/chat-human/scripts/bubble_lint.py`
Deterministic static analyzer (100% rule parity with `@nb-corp/nb-speak` `lintTurn()`):
- `bubble.empty` / `bubble.too_many` (`error`)
- `bubble.over_cjk_budget` (`>55` chars) / `bubble.over_en_budget` (`>45` words) (`warning`)
- `bubble.markdown_structure` (`error`: headers, pipe tables, fences, numbered/bold bullet walls)
- `style.trailing_period` (`warning`: short single-clause period or `663920.`)
- `style.stage_brackets` (`error`), `style.steward_cliche` (`warning`), `style.particle_spam` (`warning`)
- `style.unicode_emoji` (`warning` unless `--persona-emoji allow`), `plain.meta_leak` / `style.placeholder_leak` / `style.system_error_leak` (`error`)
- `tts.batch_root_duplication` / `tts.multiple_clips` (`error`), `tts.not_on_final_bubble` (`warning`)
- `tts.verbatim_overlap` (`>50%` bigram overlap, `error`), `tts.raw_path_or_url` (`error`), `tts.unnormalized_numbers` (`warning`)

### 3.2 `skills/chat-human/scripts/proactive_gate.py`
- Exit code `0`: emits `<proactive_tick ... />` state tag (zero canned topic strings).
- Exit code `3`: blocked by local quiet hours (`--quiet-hours 01:30-10:00`).
- Exit code `4`: blocked by cooldown, daily cap, or exponential silence-decay probability (`ack-user` resets unanswered streak).
